events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the tragic passing of influential rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: 30 years since we lost a legend. Tupac Shakur's impact on music and culture remains as powerful as ever. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: We mark the anniversary of the death of the iconic guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day.

angles.name: Hendrix's Influence
angles.copy: The guitar world changed forever when Jimi Hendrix burst onto the scene. On the anniversary of his passing, we celebrate the man who redefined rock. What's his most electrifying moment for you?

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: That legendary zebra crossing, those unforgettable tracks. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' dropped 57 years ago today. What's your favourite tune from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Celebrating 75 years of rock 'n' roll attitude! Happy Birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today, born in Manchester in 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Rock 'n' roll star and voice of a generation! Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo anthem?

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released on this day in the UK in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album
angles.copy: 55 years of 'Imagine'. John Lennon's timeless album continues to inspire peace and reflection. Which track resonates most with you?

events.title: Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The original iPod launched 25 years ago today, changing our pockets and our playlists forever. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks Global James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the 1962 premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's Global James Bond Day! Which 007 film or theme song is your absolute favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday. He was born in Liverpool in 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Imagining a world where John Lennon would be turning 86 today. His music and message continue to resonate globally. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today, born in 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'White Album' was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album
angles.copy: A sprawling masterpiece! The Beatles' 'White Album' arrived on this day in 1968. Which track from the double LP is your absolute favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: The showman, the voice, the legend. Remembering Freddie Mercury on the anniversary of his passing. What's your most cherished Queen memory?

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul
angles.copy: A pivotal album that pushed boundaries! The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' landed on this day in 1965. Which track still sounds fresh to you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day, we mark the tragic anniversary of John Lennon's death in New York City in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: 46 years since the world lost a visionary. Remembering John Lennon and his enduring message of peace and love. What's his most meaningful song to you?
